name: Sandbag Ladder

movements.notes: to one shoulder, may release one hand to show control; progressively heavier sandbags until failure to lift

origin.summary: An event from the 2022 CrossFit Games. The CrossFit Games are the season's final championship stage, where the qualified field competes across multiple events to crown the Fittest on Earth. Games events are tests first and workouts second — many use loads, formats, or venues no affiliate would program, which is exactly why they make interesting benchmarks.

description: A max-effort sandbag-clean ladder through progressively heavier bags until the athlete fails to lift one to the shoulder.
source_notes: games.crossfit.com/workouts/games/2022/10 (official CrossFit Games event), retrieved 2026-07-09; exact intermediate ladder increments between the confirmed endpoints (240-340 lb men, 160-250 lb women) are not confirmed from available sources -- flagged per CONTRIBUTING rather than guessed; tiebreak was a 3-sandbag toss over a yoke (100/150/200 lb men, 50/100/150 lb women)
